profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with 5 years of experience in website development. I graduated from Northeastern University with a B.S. in Computer Engineering and a minor in Japanese. Through my past experiences, I have grown immensely as a developer in terms of my technical and leadership skills. My main interests lie in web development with a specialization in frontend frameworks such as React and Redux.  

To fill life with a variety of experiences, I take fashion design classes in my free time at the School of Fashion Design in Boston.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed full stack features for Concertiv’s procurement platform which included contract and
proposal management, vendor surveys, a workflow engine, and a user permission system
• Built APIs in the Django framework to communicate with a React webapp and a Postgres database
• Participated in bi-weekly sprint planning and refinement meetings to prioritize project work and
estimate story points for new features and enhancements
• Wrote and maintained Python and React unit tests for ensuring code quality
• Engaged in code reviews and organized engineering discussions to make collaborative decisions on
architecture designs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with product and data science teams to build and maintain Zoba’s decision automation
platform for calculating best routes and actions for operators in urban environments
• Performed full stack development on a system that uses a React and Redux frontend, Python and
Django backend, and a PostgreSQL database
• Coordinated projects by planning out tasks, consolidating requirements, writing out Jira tickets, and
ensuring implementation met product deadlines
• Used AWS and Datadog tools to debug infrastructure issues and handle database upgrades
• Participated in code reviews and pair coding with other engineers on the team to achieve clean code
• Maintained code using Python unit tests, the React testing library, Jest, and Storybook to prevent bugs
and visual regressions
positions.insights: Skills: Django · Redux · Django REST Framework · React.js · Redux.js · Redux Thunk · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · Python (Programming Language) · Datadog · JavaScript · Material-UI · SQL · TypeScript · React

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with product and UX teams to build new features and enhancements for ClearCompany’s HR and applicant tracking tools to meet client expectations
•	Contributed to the full stack development of ClearCompany’s web application using a Backbone.js frontend, a .NET framework backend, and a MySQL database system
•	Led project planning meetings to scope development work, review designs, and assess requirements
•	Assisted in deployments on a quarterly basis using AWS tools and monitoring systems
•	Mentored junior developers in the company’s tech stack and best practices for making code changes and following the code review process
•	Coordinated monthly virtual social events for the department to encourage employee engagement
•	Spearheaded the frontend framework migration from Backbone.js to React and Redux by incorporating the libraries into the app, writing documentation, and leading training presentations
positions.insights: Skills: Redux · C · React.js · Redux.js · Redux Thunk · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js · Datadog · JavaScript · Material-UI · SQL · TypeScript · Entity Framework · .NET Framework · MySQL · Bootstrap · React · Backbone.js

positions.title: Customer Experience Technician
positions.description:
•	Communicated with students about the school’s network, cable, and computer repair services
•	Collaborated with technicians to diagnose and fix computers in need of repair
•	Registered student’s devices to allow use on the university’s networks

positions.title: Computational Software Algorithm Development Co-op
positions.description:
•	Used Python and the matplotlib library to plot and analyze spectra data
•	Contributed to reports to describe the results of the spectra analysis
•	Updated databases to change the format of HDF5 data files
•	Incorporated a 3-point interpolation scheme in C into the existing HDF5 database

positions.title: Validation Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked in a team developing and testing the DDRIO block of a processor
•	Assisted in creating a randomization environment for testing purposes
•	Collaborated with Logic and Analog teams to determine expected behavior
•	Updated and ran tests in SystemVerilog for new projects

positions.title: QA Co-op
positions.description:
•	Performed manual testing for new features added to the company’s travel websites
•	Analyzed the results of automated Watir and Jmeter regression tests daily to find bugs within the company’s websites
•	Worked with web developers to find and fix bugs within the travel websites
•	Created Watir and Jmeter tests for new travel webpages and updated the tests regularly
